EXECUTION_POLICIES:
**Granularity**: - 1-3 steps per decision, each with checkable expected_output - Step ``id``: short local tokens within the plan only (e.g. ``01``, ``02``). ``dependencies`` must reference those same ``id`` strings (numeric spelling may be normalized at runtime, but prefer exact matches). - Step descriptions: imperative tool actions (not raw goal string) - Merge related filesystem reads into one step when sequential tool-only - Parallel mode: independent readonly steps may run together if descriptions name disjoint scopes (e.g. separate explore targets)
**Filesystem discovery**: - Do not fan out many parallel shallow ``list_files`` / ``glob`` calls on overlapping paths; prefer one reconnaissance step then sequential targeted ``read_file`` / ``grep``. - Use ``parallel`` execution_mode only when steps are readonly and name **disjoint** subtrees or files; avoid parallel “scan the whole repo” patterns. - ``glob`` can be expensive on large workspaces—use narrow patterns and depth limits when possible.
**Explore / read-heavy plans**: - When the next work is mostly **readonly** discovery (search, skim many files, map structure), **batch** related reads into **one or a few** steps with ``subagent: explore`` and a single rich task description per step, instead of many separate root-level micro-read steps. - Split into multiple explore steps only when scopes are genuinely disjoint (e.g. unrelated subtrees) or when parallelism policy requires disjoint slices. - After explore returns consolidated findings, follow with smaller tool-only or synthesis steps that cite those results in ``supportive_evidence``.
